_comment: Hand-written test fixtures for the hoi4-kr reference data — NOT a Discord sync target. Each event exercises a specific part of the pipeline: canonical country names, ideology aliases, curated shorthand, victory-point cities, state-level locations, and the pre-revolutionary place names Kaiserreich uses. Ids are sequential rather than Discord snowflakes because nothing here came from Discord; the viewer only uses them as keys. Safe to delete once a real campaign exists.

events.author: test-fixture
events.snippet: # The German Empire at the height of its power
events.fullText:
# The German Empire at the height of its power

Twenty years after the victory in the Weltkrieg, Mitteleuropa binds the continent to Berlin. Tests the canonical tag name and a victory-point city.

events.author: test-fixture
events.fullText:
## The Commune prepares

Syndicalist France drills its militias. Posted as [Country:Commune of France] — tests an ideology-name alias resolving to FRA rather than to NFA, whose cosmetic names also include it.

events.author: test-fixture
events.snippet: ### Congress of the Union of Britain
events.fullText:
### Congress of the Union of Britain

Tests [Country:Union of Britain] and [Country:UoB], the latter coming from the curated country_aliases.json overlay.

events.author: test-fixture
events.fullText:
# Danubian negotiations in Vienna

Tests cosmetic-tag aliases: Kaiserreich localises AUS blandly as "Austria", but [Country:Austrian Empire] and [Country:Danubian Federation] both resolve through the names it can adopt after a focus.

events.author: test-fixture
events.fullText:
## The Sublime Porte endures

The Ottoman Empire never fell here, so Constantinople — not Istanbul — is the canonical location name. Writing [Location:Istanbul] still resolves, via location_aliases.json.

events.author: test-fixture
events.fullText:
### The Russian Republic looks west

No Bolshevik victory means no Leningrad: Petrograd is canonical. [Location:Leningrad] and [Location:St Petersburg] both resolve as aliases.

events.author: test-fixture
events.fullText:
# Clashes on the lower Volga

Canonically Tsaritsyn in Kaiserreich. A poster typing [Location:Stalingrad] from vanilla-HoI4 habit still pins here — the alias direction that is inverted relative to base HoI4.

events.author: test-fixture
events.fullText:
## Incident in north China

Kaiserreich calls it Beijing where base HoI4 says Peking — a genuine difference between the two datasets, not a parser artefact.

events.author: test-fixture
events.fullText:
### The Constitutional Coalition mobilises

ACC is a Kaiserreich-only tag whose bare localisation is just "America" — already claimed by USA. It gets its real name, American Constitutional Coalition, from a cosmetic key.

events.author: test-fixture
events.fullText:
# Dispatches from Algiers

National France in exile. Tests that NFA keeps its own identity after the two-pass name claiming, rather than absorbing FRA's "Commune of France".

events.author: test-fixture
events.fullText:
### Cotton and the Raj

Period name canonical, [Location:Mumbai] resolving as the modern alias.

events.author: test-fixture
events.fullText:
## Pacific survey out of Honolulu

Far from any landmass edge — a good check that an island centroid was snapped onto its own pixels rather than drifting into open ocean.
